scope_note: Training cohort with nine explicit permit, inspection, license and event records at one observation point. The event status transition is a deliberate review example. Use the agreed population and mappings for a commissioned acceptance run.

scenarios.title: Building and linked Fire finalization
scenarios.criterion: A Building permit reaches Finalized only after every linked Fire permit reaches Finalized. Review the actual linked case IDs and observe the corresponding lifecycle behavior.

scenarios.title: Open departmental review ownership and due dates
scenarios.criterion: Every selected open Fire, Public Works or Land Use review retains its assigned reviewer and due date. Confirm the actual department vocabulary and open states with the export owner.
